[MITM]
hostname = app-api.smzdm.com, *.zdmimg.com, homepage-api.smzdm.com, haojia-api.smzdm.com, haojia.m.smzdm.com, baike-api.smzdm.com, s-api.smzdm.com, zhiyou.m.smzdm.com

^https?:\/\/haojia\.m\.smzdm\.com\/detail_modul\/wiki_related_modul - reject

http-response ^https?:\/\/haojia-api\.smzdm\.com\/home\/list, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/smzdm_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
